name: shinchantw_cbt_first_day_1_4_repeat_d1_retention_20260730_205659_597854
sql:
/*
===============================================================================
目的：比较 2026-07-29 首日进入「入门:1-4」但当日未到「入门:1-5」的玩家，
      在 1-4 内有无重复挑战时的次日登录留存。

口径：
  - 人群：当日创角，且挑战过主线 stage_fight（key = 1001）。
  - 重试组：任一「入门:1-4」关卡挑战次数 >= 2。
  - 对照组：进入过「入门:1-4」，但该段所有关卡均只挑战 1 次。
  - 两组均排除当日已进入「入门:1-5」的玩家。
  - 事件没有服务端胜负字段；重试只是未过/受阻代理，不能当作真实失败。
===============================================================================
*/
WITH UserBlacklist AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" AS user_id
    FROM user_result_cluster_18
    WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users', 'is_windows', 'is_water')
),
CohortUsers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT v."#account_id" AS account_id
    FROM ta.v_event_18 v
    LEFT JOIN UserBlacklist b ON v."#user_id" = b.user_id
    WHERE v."$part_event" = 'new_role'
      AND v."$part_date" = '2026-07-29'
      AND v."#account_id" IS NOT NULL
      AND b.user_id IS NULL
),
StageMap AS (
    SELECT
        TRY_CAST("stage_id@stage_id" AS BIGINT) AS stage_id,
        MAX("stage_id@stage_name_show") AS stage_name
    FROM ta_dim.dim_18_0_52765
    GROUP BY 1
),
StageStats AS (
    SELECT
        v."#account_id" AS account_id,
        m.stage_name,
        COALESCE(TRY_CAST(v.a_rst[1].id AS BIGINT), TRY_CAST(v.stage_id AS BIGINT)) AS stage_id,
        COUNT(*) AS attempts
    FROM ta.v_event_18 v
    INNER JOIN CohortUsers c ON v."#account_id" = c.account_id
    LEFT JOIN UserBlacklist b ON v."#user_id" = b.user_id
    LEFT JOIN StageMap m
      ON m.stage_id = COALESCE(TRY_CAST(v.a_rst[1].id AS BIGINT), TRY_CAST(v.stage_id AS BIGINT))
    WHERE v."#event_name" = 'stage_fight'
      AND TRY_CAST(v.a_rst[1].key AS INTEGER) = 1001
      AND v."$part_date" = '2026-07-29'
      AND b.user_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
),
EligibleUsers AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        MAX(CASE WHEN stage_name = '入门:1-4' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS reached_1_4,
        MAX(CASE WHEN stage_name = '入门:1-5' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS reached_1_5,
        MAX(CASE WHEN stage_name = '入门:1-4' AND attempts >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS repeated_1_4,
        SUM(CASE WHEN stage_name = '入门:1-4' THEN attempts ELSE 0 END) AS attempts_in_1_4
    FROM StageStats
    GROUP BY 1
),
NextDayLogin AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT v."#account_id" AS account_id
    FROM ta.v_event_18 v
    LEFT JOIN UserBlacklist b ON v."#user_id" = b.user_id
    WHERE v."$part_event" = 'login'
      AND v."$part_date" = CAST(DATE_ADD('day', 1, DATE '2026-07-29') AS VARCHAR)
      AND b.user_id IS NULL
),
GroupedUsers AS (
    SELECT
        e.account_id,
        e.attempts_in_1_4,
        CASE WHEN e.repeated_1_4 = 1 THEN '1-4 内重复挑战（推断受阻）'
             ELSE '1-4 无重复挑战（对照）' END AS player_group,
        CASE WHEN l.account_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS d1_login
    FROM EligibleUsers e
    LEFT JOIN NextDayLogin l ON e.account_id = l.account_id
    WHERE e.reached_1_4 = 1
      AND e.reached_1_5 = 0
)
SELECT
    player_group AS "玩家分组",
    COUNT(*) AS "玩家数",
    ROUND(AVG(attempts_in_1_4), 2) AS "1-4内平均挑战次数",
    SUM(d1_login) AS "D1登录人数",
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(d1_login) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "D1留存率(%)"
FROM GroupedUsers
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY "玩家分组";
